crossRefs.note: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
“But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
But he who endures to the end will be saved.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…

Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is…
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords.

translations.web: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
translations.bsb: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
translations.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
translations.asv: Then cometh the end, when he shall deliver up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
